name: diagram_tool
description: Generate diagrams (flowcharts, architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams) from Graphviz DOT language. Renders via dot.exe with auto-download if missing. Outputs PNG or SVG to doc/ by default. DOT capabilities: digraph/graph, rankdir (TB/LR), shapes (box/diamond/ellipse/record/note), subgraph cluster_*, labels, style/fillcolor/color.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Graphviz DOT language code describing the diagram.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Output filename without extension. Can include subdirectory (e.g. 'proJV/doc/diagram'). Default: 'diagram'
